method.primary_metric: surface-form token count for canonical speech events
method.deduplication: 4-token shingle containment; one canonical source per event
method.topic_layer: curated lexical signals; overlapping categories are allowed
method.mbg_rule: exact MBG/full phrase or contextual makan+bergizi/SPPG signal; ambiguous acronym evidence is reported separately
method.warning: caption windows/tracks are not verified audio ground truth; topic signals need spot review before publication
